sentences.en: Do not make any modifications before you get confirmations.
sentences.zh: 在收到确认之前，不要做任何修改。

sentences.en: Democrats and tribal groups hailed Haaland's confirmation as historic.
sentences.zh: 民主党人和部落团体将哈兰德的任命视为历史性的时刻。

sentences.en: Please cancel my order and send confirmation that this has been done.
sentences.zh: 请取消我的订单，并发送已取消的确认信息。

senses.zh: 确认，证实；批准，认可；确认书，证明书；（基督教的）坚信礼，坚振礼
